seo.title: Singapore — homeless and housing-crisis help - No Home Help
seo.description: Verified contacts for shelter, food, health, government support, work, documents and legal help.

page.heading: Singapore — homeless and housing-crisis help
page.urgent: Police: 999. Ambulance or fire: 995. ComCare: 1800 222 0000. For a rough sleeper in immediate danger, call emergency services; otherwise use Help Neighbour or ComCare.
page.notice: Services, opening times, eligibility and available places can change. Call first when possible. A listing does not guarantee a bed, meal, payment, treatment or job.
page.intro: Say where you are, whether you have a safe place tonight, any urgent illness or injury, whether children are with you, and which identification documents you have.

entries.title: ComCare Hotline
entries.description: Ask for the nearest Social Service Office or Family Service Centre, financial help, and a homelessness or shelter assessment. State where you are and whether you need a safe place tonight.

entries.title: Safe, Sound Sleeping Places (S3Ps)
entries.description: Free interim overnight spaces in community premises, with a safe place to sleep, wash and charge a phone. Access is normally through an SSO or FSC assessment; locations and places change.

entries.title: Transitional shelters
entries.description: Temporary shared accommodation for individuals and families who have exhausted other housing options, with onsite social work and a longer-term housing plan. Start at an FSC or SSO; a same-day bed is not guaranteed.

entries.title: Family Service Centres
entries.description: Walk-in social work support for housing, family and personal crises, counselling and referrals. Use the MSF directory or ComCare to locate the nearest centre.
entries.hours: Typically weekdays; confirm with the centre

entries.title: Social Service Offices — ComCare
entries.description: Financial assistance for low-income people and families, including help with basic living costs. Staff can also connect rough sleepers to employment and shelter services. Bring ID and financial information if available.

entries.title: Workforce Singapore Career Centres
entries.description: Career guidance, job matching and training support for Singapore citizens and permanent residents. Ask an SSO or FSC for help if you lack internet, an address or documents.

entries.title: National Anti-Violence and Sexual Harassment Helpline
entries.description: For family violence, abuse or sexual harassment, including advice and referral to protection services. If violence is happening now, call 999.

entries.title: Help Neighbour — rough sleeper referral
entries.description: With the person’s agreement where possible, submit their location and needs so a social service agency can follow up. Do not photograph or share personal details publicly.
